newsitem.title: USA: FGIC qualifies 7 muni bond issues for insurance.
newsitem.headline: FGIC qualifies 7 muni bond issues for insurance.

text.p: Financial Guaranty Insurance Co. said that it qualified for bond insurance the following seven municipal bond issues scheduled for competitive sale on Thursday.
--Palm Springs, US.D., Calif, General Obligations (GO), $10 million under optional bidding.
--San Jose Clean Water, Calif., $35.085 million under optional bidding.
--Scotts Valley, U.S.D., Calif, GOs, $18.2 million under optional bidding.
--Fort Wayne, Ind., $7.1 million water revs is a direct purchase.
--Armstrong S.D., Penn., GO, $17.44 million is under alternate bidding.
